title: Introducing: Tenant Discovery Endpoint (2025 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Demo Setup and Logic App Overview

features.name: Tenant Discovery Endpoint
features.description: An API endpoint that provides a list of tenants to which an app has access, enabling partners to discover and manage customer environments across different tenants.

features.name: Manageable Tenants API
features.description: An API that returns a list of tenants that can be managed by an authenticating app, used in the tenant discovery workflow.

features.name: S2S App Authentication for Admin Center API
features.description: Service-to-service app authentication mechanism for the admin center API that was built previously and extended with the tenant discovery endpoint.
